title: .luaurc
description: Luau's configuration for the files in this folder and its subfolders. A folder's .luaurc changes its parent folder's.

languageMode.description: How strictly types are checked. A file's own `--!strict`, `--!nonstrict`, or `--!nocheck` comment wins.
enumDescriptions: Check types, assuming `any` where a type can't be inferred.
Check types, inferring them as precisely as possible.

lint.description: Which lints are on, by name; `"*"` sets them all.

GlobalUsedAsLocal.description: A global used only in one function, as a local would be.

LocalShadow.description: A local with the name of another in scope.

SameLineStatement.description: Statements on one line that look like one.

MultiLineStatement.description: A statement split across lines confusingly.

FunctionUnused.description: A local function that's never used.

ImportUnused.description: A required module that's never used.

UnknownType.description: Comparing `type()` or `typeof()` with a type that doesn't exist.

ForRange.description: A numeric for loop that doesn't run, or runs strangely.

UnbalancedAssignment.description: Assigning more or fewer values than variables.

ImplicitReturn.description: A function that returns values on some paths and nothing on others.

DuplicateLocal.description: Two locals of one name in one statement.

FormatString.description: An invalid format or pattern string.

TableLiteral.description: A key given twice in a table.

UninitializedLocal.description: A local read before it's assigned.

TableOperations.description: A table library call that's likely wrong.

MisleadingAndOr.description: `a and b or c` where `b` may be false or nil.

IntegerParsing.description: An integer literal that's out of range or ambiguous.

ComparisonPrecedence.description: A comparison that reads as another, such as `not a == b`.

RedundantNativeAttribute.description: `@native` on a function in a native module.

lintErrors.description: Report lints as errors rather than warnings.

globals.description: Extra global names, which aren't reported as unknown.

aliases.description: Names for folders, for requires: `require("@name/module")`. Paths are relative to the folder of this .luaurc.
